title: It’s very easy to inflate, but it doesn’t stay inflated all night
text: It’s very easy to inflate, but it doesn’t stay inflated all night. There is nothing to dislike about this pillow. I need it at night to support my neck because I sleep in a recliner. The hand pump is great for me because I have tremors from Parkinson’s and blowing up a pillow and then getting the cap on before it deflates is difficult. I don’t know what the fabric is but it is the only travel pillow I’ve used that doesn’t make my neck sweaty.

product_metadata.title: KUKTDUD Inflatable Neck Travel Pillow，Self-Inflatable,Airplane Travel Essentials,for Office Sleeping Rest,Adjustable Support Hardness,Skin-Friendly &Breathable Fabric， Soft Washable Cover
features: 【Instructions for use】: The first step, open the package to remove the headrest and confirm that the air release valve is closed, the second step manually press the round inflatable pump, the whole process requires 30-50 presses, you can adjust the size to your preferred inflation level and firmness.

【Skin-friendly fabrics】: The pillowcase is made of skin-friendly plush velvet, delicate and soft to take care of your skin, suitable for both adults and children. The pillowcase is designed with an easy-to-use zipper, easy to clean, and completely machine washable.
【Ergonomic]】：Unique patented design. Perfectly supports the head and neck bones. Thanks to the lightweight design, it is not uncomfortable and breathable even after long hours of wear.
【Portable】 ： It is the size of a cell phone (6 x 6.7 inches) when stored away, so it does not take up much space and is easy to carry.

【Perfect gift]】： Not only can be used in airplanes, but also in trains, cars, offices and homes. Prepare this neck pillow for your parents, relatives and friends, it will be a healthy gift full of love!
